I clicked **Save** and got the green checkmark saying "Bookmark saved." That part's clear — it did save.

But to answer your actual question: no, it doesn't really reassure me on that point. The message is generic — it just says "the title and description are now in your library" without showing me *which* title. Since the whole reason I shortened it was to fix a clunky title, I'd want the confirmation to actually show me the version that got saved — the shortened title I typed, and ideally the description too — so I can see with my own eyes that my edits are what landed, not the original the page came with. Could you have it echo back what I actually saved?
